title: Gift from the Demonic Path Commander
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji had yet to recover from this earth-shattering truth, a familiar scent that made his heart stop abruptly emerged from the direction of the Celestial Realm's boundary—the unique aura of his mother Chen Xuan, mingling ice, snow, and sandalwood, as if awakened by this shocking confrontation, slowly drifting toward where he stood.

text.content: In the instant golden light pierced the heavens, Chen Ji felt his blood ignite, boiling and roaring through his veins. This was Heavenly Fate Resonance—a phenomenon only the purest inheritor of the Chen family's bloodline could trigger. He abruptly turned toward the direction of the mortal ancestral homeland, where a pillar of light shot straight up to the heavens, as if declaring to the entire cultivation world the return of the Chen bloodline.

dialogue.content: "As expected, it's you." The Demonic Path Commander's voice sounded behind Chen Ji, the face shrouded in mist seemingly revealing a faint smile. "Ten thousand cycles of reincarnation, and karma has finally come to fruition. Take this list."

text.content: An ancient jade slip appeared before Chen Ji out of thin air. The slip was pitch black, yet seven distinct lights swirled across its surface, each light like a living soul breathing. Chen Ji reached out and took it, and the moment his fingertips touched the jade slip, a vast sea of memories threatened to overwhelm him.

dialogue.content: "This is the list left by the Chess Player ten thousand years ago." The Commander's voice grew low. "Seven Chess Players, seven different paths of destiny. However, this seventh one... was never supposed to be you."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed intently. Within the jade slip, a blurry image emerged: a man bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji was standing beneath the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, receiving the coronation of fate. Yet in the next instant, the image twisted, the man's face was hastily erased, replaced by a blank space.

dialogue.content: "The seventh Chess Player was supposed to be someone else." The Commander's voice carried a barely perceptible sigh. "But Cang Yutian discovered the Chen family's bloodline secret. He needed a vessel to承载 the complete power of the Tianji Record. So he chose your mother."

text.content: The fingers holding the jade slip turned white. Chen Ji's mind conjured his mother's gentle yet resolute face, remembering her words—"Ji'er, the luckiest thing in Mother's life was choosing you." At that time, he didn't understand the weight of those words. Now, he felt as if struck by thunder.

dialogue.content: "Chen Xuan was originally a Chess Player candidate. Cang Yutian chose her, cultivating her into the perfect vessel." The Commander continued, "However, she discovered the truth, realized she was merely a chess piece of the Heavenly Dao, so she chose to resist—and the price of that resistance was you."

text.content: The jade slip displayed another scene: Chen Xuan kneeling beneath the Heavenly Eye, holding an infant in her arms,剥离 her power of fate-writing inch by inch, injecting it into that small body. That infant was Chen Ji. Tears silently slid down Chen Ji's cheeks.

dialogue.content: "She used every means possible to hide you, making Cang Yutian believe the plan had failed, making the Heavenly Eye think the vessel was destroyed." The Commander's voice held reverence. "She traded her death for your chance to survive. And now, your very existence is the greatest comfort to her."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting tears flow freely. Beneath his mother's serene face lay what tumultuous waves? She swallowed all suffering alone, just so he could live as an ordinary person. He tightly gripped the jade slip, his knuckles white.

choice.prompt: Having learned the complete truth of his mother's sacrifice, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Transform grief into fuel for calculation, continue asking for intelligence about the Heavenly Eye and Cang Yutian
choices.visible_cost: Suppressing emotions may harm the body
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence, paving the way for revenge

dialogue.content: "You're quite composed." The Commander seemed to see through Chen Ji's disguise but didn't expose it. "Fine, ask away. What do you want to know?"

choices.text: Face it honestly, allow yourself to be vulnerable
choices.description: At this moment, discard the mask, express gratitude and determination to this elder who knows everything
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Commander's deeper trust and assistance

dialogue.content: The Commander fell silent for a moment, then sighed softly: "You're just like your mother—clearly heartbroken to the core, yet still forcing yourself to finish asking all the questions. Rest assured, I will tell you everything I know."

choices.text: Stay vigilant, probe the other's motives
choices.description: There's no free lunch in this world. Why would this Demonic Path Commander help him? Is there a deeper scheme behind it?
choices.visible_reward: See through the enemy's cards, avoid being used

dialogue.content: "Hahaha!" The Commander suddenly burst into laughter. "Good, good! Chen Ji! If Chen Xuan had knowledge of this from the underworld, she would surely be gratified to have given birth to a son as suspicious as herself. Rest easy, I help you not out of goodwill, but because our enemies are the same."

"When Chen Xuan transferred the power of fate-writing to you back then, she carved three layers of seals into your soul." The Commander extended a finger, lightly tapping Chen Ji's brow center. "The first layer veils your true identity; the second isolates the Heavenly Eye's scrutiny; the third... is the lock protecting your sister."

text.content: Chen Nian. Chen Ji's heart ached. That sister who had been missing for years—he had never stopped searching, yet every time he lost his way in the mists of fate. So it wasn't that he couldn't find her, but his mother's power was protecting her from being discovered. "Nian'er... is she still alive?"

dialogue.content: "Alive, and living more splendidly than anyone." The Commander's tone carried a complex note. "The Holy Sect treats her as a Heavenly Fate Lock Key because her existence can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. With her around, the future you see becomes blurry—this is precisely what the Heavenly Eye fears most."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his mind racing. His sister was an interference source, and the Heavenly Eye feared this interference... What did that mean? It meant that as long as he found Chen Nian, she would become a key piece against the Heavenly Eye. Mother's布局 extended even this far.

dialogue.content: "This is all the help I can give you." The Commander's form began to fade. "The road ahead, you must walk yourself. But there is one thing I can promise you—no matter the outcome, I will buy you enough time."

text.content: "Buy time?" Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze sharp. "What are you going to do?"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye has already noticed you." The Commander's form grew fainter and fainter. "It will send its true pieces to test you. And I... will ensure those pieces never reach you—this is probably the last thing I can do for you."

text.content: Chen Ji lunged forward, but caught only empty air. The Commander's form had completely dissipated in the wind, leaving only words echoing between heaven and earth: "Chen Ji, live well. This chess game, you are the only variable. And variables... are the sole hope for breaking through the Heavenly Dao."

The golden light gradually faded. Chen Ji stood alone, clutching the jade slip tightly in his hand. His mother's sacrifice, his sister's secret, the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy—all the clues intertwined at this moment, forming an enormous chess game he had never seen before. And he, finally, saw his position in this game clearly.

He slowly raised his head, gazing toward the direction of the Celestial Realm's boundary. There, a faint, intangible aura was slowly drifting over—the unique scent of his mother Chen Xuan, mingling ice, snow, and sandalwood. A person dead for many years, why would their aura appear there? Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply, an indescribable premonition surging in his chest.

As if sensing something, the list within the jade slip began to grow warm. Chen Ji looked down to see the position of the seventh Chess Player, where the originally blurry blank space was slowly coalescing into a character—"陈" (Chen). At that moment, he seemed to hear his mother's gentle voice whispering in his ear: "Ji'er, survive. Mother has always been watching over you."

choice.prompt: Faced with the sudden appearance of his mother's aura, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Immediately track the source of the aura
choices.description: Even if it's a trap, he must go see. His mother's aura couldn't appear without reason
choices.visible_reward: May discover his mother's secrets or relics
choices.risk_hint: The path ahead is unknown, risks are extremely high

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji prepared to move, a black shadow tore through the void, striking directly for his heart! An assassin! Chen Ji dodged sideways, cold intent flickering in his eyes—the Heavenly Eye certainly couldn't wait any longer.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to deduce possible developments within the next three hours, finding the optimal timing for action

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He retrieved the Tianji Record Fragment, slowly pouring spiritual energy into it—even if it meant consuming precious Heavenly Fate, he must see the full picture of this game. The patterns on the fragment began to glow, blurry images emerging before his eyes.

choices.text: Send word to allies to rendezvous
choices.description: Notify Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, have three people investigate together to prevent falling into a trap

dialogue.content: Chen Ji retrieved the communication jade talisman, pouring spiritual energy into it and murmuring a few words. After a moment, Su Qingyao's clear voice came through: "Where are you? What's happened?" Her tone carried a rare hint of urgency—clearly she had already sensed something was wrong.

text.content: However, at this moment, from the direction of the Celestial Realm's boundary, that familiar aura suddenly grew dense. An icy chill crawled up from the soles of Chen Ji's feet to his heart—that wasn't ordinary aura residue, but a living, moving life sign. His mother's soul... had not dispersed?

dialogue.content: An elderly yet authoritative voice suddenly exploded in Chen Ji's mind: "Interesting... A remnant soul from ten thousand years ago, yet still maintaining such complete consciousness. Chen Xuan, did you think hiding in the gaps of fate could escape my perception?"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This was the Heavenly Eye's voice—the supreme will transcending all. He had never imagined his first direct encounter with this ultimate existence would be under such circumstances. His mother's aura... had been discovered?

"Ji'er..." A gentle voice that shattered Chen Ji's heart sounded within his mind—his mother's voice, weak yet resolute. "Don't be afraid, Mother is here. No matter what happens, Mother will protect you. This time, it's Mother's turn to守护 you." The words fell, and that aura surged violently, like a dazzling sword light, shooting straight toward the heavens!

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, fists clenched tight. He saw that familiar sword light charge into the heavens, confronting an invisible Heavenly Eye. His mother's remnant soul, single-handedly, was buying him time to escape! No! He couldn't run, he couldn't let his mother face this alone again!

Yet a gentle force suddenly emanated from that sword light, softly pushing Chen Ji away. A familiar voice sounded in his ear—no longer weak, but carrying unprecedented determination: "Ji'er, remember, you are Mother's greatest pride. Survive, take good care of Nian'er. Mother... can only send you this far." The moment the words faded, a thunderous roar exploded across the heavens. Chen Xuan's remnant soul transformed into countless specks of light, scattering across the earth like stars in the night sky. And that Heavenly Eye... actually retreated.
